mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.0% as of the decision date) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following a UNRATE level above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4.0% and the federal funds rate is above 3.5%, it indicates a tight labor market combined with restrictive monetary policy, which historically precedes equity market downturns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following the joint condition (UNRATE < 4.0% AND FEDFUNDS > 3.5%).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential sales (RSAFS > 750,000) reflects strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following RSAFS > 750,000.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 1500.0) indicates robust consumer spending and economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 60-day periods following HOUST > 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 330.0 (indicating high cumulative inflation) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following CPIAUCSL > 330.0.
